snippet.title: Croakspire - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now! - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3744870/Croakspire/

Dive into a fortress labyrinth crawling with monsters, defending yourself with your... tongue? As a frog, it's your best bet to traverse this retro-inspired 2D metroidvania title. Collect treasures to gain permanent upgrades to your moveset, and discover new areas of the massive interconnected map with them! A plethora of secrets await in unlikely locations...

With your tongue, you can engage in precise combat, using a slew of equippable tongue-whips and secondary weapons to your advantage. You'll need them when facing intimidating bosses with complex attack patterns. Customize your stats with a variety of item pickups to build a playstyle you prefer!

The lakeside castle awaits your arrival... Will you heed its call and brave the night?

Join the discord: https://discord.gg/F9RnFgH8e2
